meta.protocol: PROTOCOL_P3.md criteria C1-C5 with amendment A5: posterior stems (Wiener consistency projection) in all subtraction identities; refinement w/ env likelihood selection + theta grid line-search; E1 on K>=2 only; primary test scene-paired Wilcoxon
meta.locality: A12.2 proxy: loc = si_sdr((est - ref) + noedit_ref, noedit_ref); noedit_ref = y - gts[k] for E1/E2/E3; for E4 noedit_ref = y (pre-edit mixture as its own reference frame: all nodes re-rendered, no untouched bed). For E1 ref == noedit_ref, so loc == sisdr by construction (recorded). The proxy charges node-render error to locality (conservative) but is computable for EVERY system incl. the regeneration family.
meta.loc_clean: clean non-target damage for identity-based edits: est = y - s_hat_k + node', so est - node' = y - s_hat_k EXACTLY and loc_clean = si_sdr(y - s_hat_k, y - gts_k); node-render error excluded. E1: node' = 0 -> loc_clean == loc == sisdr. E4: undefined (whole scene re-rendered, no bed survives; proxy only). Regeneration family (X5/X6): undefined, proxy only (no node decomposition exists).
meta.oracle_E4: A12.5 rung -> rows.S4.E4: GT stems + estimated alpha, mixture-level dereverb + re-render (coincides with S3's mixture path since GT stems sum to y and the dereverb is linear -- documented); ORE4A = GT stems + GT alpha (oracle-alpha), isolating the absorption-estimate cost; its residual = semi-analytic inverse approximation gap (L2)
